answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain. Consider a ripple as the anchor of the cost.
